title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Returned-Transfer Remainder in Catch-Up Deposits
content:
**Cartwise Shopper Payouts — training notes on the returned part in a catch-up deposit**

These notes explain how a catch-up deposit on a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account treats the part of the latest returned transfer that no re-send deposit has yet carried.

**What is "the returned part"?**
It is the amount of the latest returned-transfer entry on the account (the entry recording that a deposit or cashout came back) less every re-send deposit already pointing to that entry, never below zero, rounded to the cent. Where no re-send deposit points to it, the returned part is the entry's whole amount.

**How is the returned part treated?**
The part of the latest returned transfer that no re-send deposit has yet carried is treated by return history:

| Returned-transfer entries on the account in the last 12 months | Shopper level | Kept on the balance |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Any level | The whole returned part, for a later re-send |
| Exactly one | Full-Service Shopper Gold or below | Half of the returned part, rounded to the cent |
| Exactly one | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | Nothing — the part is swept with the rest |
| None | Any level | Nothing — the part is swept with the rest |

Whatever is kept stays on the balance and is not part of the catch-up deposit.

**What counts as "the last 12 months"?**
The returned-transfer entries booked on the account fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the catch-up.

**How are levels read?**
Shopper level is taken from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or below" is read in that order; Gold or below therefore covers Shop-Only Shopper up to and including Full-Service Shopper Gold.

**A hypothetical case.**
The latest returned-transfer entry is for 180.00 and a re-send deposit of 100.00 points to it, so the returned part is 80.00.
- With two returned-transfer entries in the last 12 months, 80.00 is kept on the balance.
- With exactly one such entry and a Full-Service Shopper Silver level, half, 40.00, is kept.
- With exactly one such entry and a Full-Service Shopper Diamond level, nothing is kept.

**A second hypothetical case.**
The latest returned-transfer entry is for 75.00 and re-send deposits pointing to it total 75.00. The returned part is 0.00, so nothing is kept whatever the history.
